claim: Patchline ships a reproducible RL repair policy with a deterministic post-hoc verification layer. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the reproducible RL policy claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make reproducible-rl-repair-policy-gate`.
